The plan

Repository
educationaltestingservice/rsmtool
Base commit
d7e776b (image tag)
Issue
Refactor CLI tests to call `main()` functions instead of calling the entry points CodeCov wants people to switch to their [binary uploader](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/codecov-uploader) instead of using the `codecov` package. However, in my tests (as part of #636), I found that when I switch to the new uploader, we were losing coverage – mainly because the [coverage subprocess measurement](https://coverage.readthedocs.io/en/7.2.7/subprocess.html) was not working as intended. Since we can't stay on the codecov python package forever, we will need to refactor our CLI tests so that instead of calling the entry point directly via `subprocess()`, we call the `main` function as we do in SKLL. There are two tasks in this issue: - [ ] Refactor CLI tests - [ ] Switch to the binary CodeCov uploader
Files to edit
  • rsmtool/rsmcompare.py
  • rsmtool/rsmeval.py
  • rsmtool/rsmexplain.py
  • rsmtool/rsmpredict.py
  • rsmtool/rsmsummarize.py
  • rsmtool/rsmxval.py
Approach
Modify each main() function to accept an optional argv parameter. When argv is provided, use it instead of sys.argv for argument parsing. This maintains backward compatibility while allowing tests to call main() with explicit arguments. Planner dropped nonexistent files: ["rsmtool/rstool.py"]
